loc <- Sys.setlocale("LC_MESSAGES", "en_US.UTF-8")

library("RColorBrewer")
library("gplots")

input <- read.delim('/galaxy/server/database/objects/3/8/e/dataset_38e45c6d-bd7c-4e5a-a70f-247e0775c77f.dat', sep='\t', header=TRUE)

mat_input <- data.matrix(input[,2:ncol(input)])
rownames(mat_input) <- input[,1]

    linput <- mat_input

    scale <- "row"

srtCol <- 30
    rlabs <- NULL
    clabs <- NULL
    label_margins <- c(8,8)

    dendrogramtoplot <- "column"
        reorder_cols <- TRUE
        reorder_rows <- FALSE
        # Layout is:
        # nothing                               | 4 = color key
        # nothing                               | 3 = dendrogram for columns
        # 2 = dendrogram for rows (not plotted) | 1 = heatmap
        layout_matrix <- rbind(c(0, 4), c(0, 3), c(2, 1))
        key_margins <- list(mar=c(1, 5, 1, 10))
        lheight <- c(0.5, 1, 5)
        lwidth <- c(0.01, 1)
    hclust_fun <- function(x) hclust(x, method='complete')
        dist_fun <- function(x) as.dist(1 - cor(t(x)))

ncolors <- 50
    colused <- brewer.pal(ncolors, "YlOrBr")

    png(file='/galaxy/server/database/jobs_directory/001/1575/outputs/dataset_ca285a2b-8bcc-4b9f-9b4b-9da6f2c63750.dat', res=240, height=2000, width=2000)

heatmap.2(linput, dendrogram=dendrogramtoplot, Colv=reorder_cols, Rowv=reorder_rows,
    distfun=dist_fun, hclustfun=hclust_fun, scale = scale, labRow = rlabs, labCol = clabs,
    col=colused, trace="none", density.info = "none", margins=label_margins,
    main = '', cexCol=0.8, cexRow=0.8, srtCol=srtCol,
    keysize=3, key.xlab='', key.title='', key.par=key_margins,
    lmat=layout_matrix, lhei=lheight, lwid=lwidth)

dev.off()
        null device 
          1
